name: Shenzhen Cheng Chung Design Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Cheng Chung Design Co., Ltd., with its headquarters located in Shenzhen, China, specializes in providing comprehensive interior design, engineering, and construction services throughout the country. The company undertakes projects for a variety of clients, including hotels, residential developments, office buildings, private clubs, and extensive commercial complexes. Founded in 1994, the firm originally operated under the name Shenzhen Asiantime International Construction Co., Ltd.
